from scipy.ndimage import label
def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid,dtype=int)
    lab,n=label(a==0)
    sizes=sorted(((int((lab==i).sum()),i) for i in range(1,n+1)), reverse=True)
    for color,(_,i) in zip((8,7),sizes): a[lab==i]=color
    return a.tolist()
')
